controls.name: Domain knowledge and semantics
controls.purpose: Make concepts, identifiers, relationships, metadata, temporal meaning, provenance, uncertainty and fitness for purpose explicit.

controls.name: Authority, identity and policy
controls.purpose: Authenticate actors and workloads, preserve delegated authority, evaluate licence and purpose, and attach obligations.

controls.name: Durable workflow and human control
controls.purpose: Make multi-step processes deterministic, resumable, reviewable and reversible rather than relying on an LLM plan.

controls.name: MCP, APIs and events
controls.purpose: Provide policy-filtered discovery, invocation, routing, service contracts and event integration.

controls.name: Authoritative systems, data and computation
controls.purpose: Keep source systems authoritative and perform deterministic geospatial and statistical operations in tested software.

controls.name: Evidence, audit and assurance
controls.purpose: Record requests, policy decisions, approvals, data versions, transformations, outputs, receipts and operational assurance.

planes.name: Presentation plane
planes.trust_boundary: No protected credentials or licensed feature payloads in public browser assets.

planes.name: Control plane
planes.trust_boundary: Every discover and invoke decision requires trusted identity and policy context.

planes.name: Execution and data plane
planes.trust_boundary: Provider credentials and licensed data stay server-side and tier-isolated.

planes.name: Evidence plane
planes.trust_boundary: Evidence is immutable enough for challenge and reconstructability; logs exclude secrets and unnecessary personal query content.
